author_scope: New Segue 1-like core/cusp mock comparison; 64 stars per catalogue explicitly selected by author. Halo rs is a controlled choice, not an observed Segue 1 halo fit.

normalization.method: rho_s solved analytically for equal M at the common 3D Plummer half-light radius; same rs=150 pc.

observations.selection: position only; random eligible pool subset; no velocity clipping

scope: Two single-realization DF recovery examples; no coverage or calibration claim. beta_ani=-0.5 is a common generation choice; validate DF before sampling. Untruncated analytic halo density; potential tends to zero at infinity. Negligible stellar self gravity.

literature_choices.photometry: Simon et al. 2011 / Martin et al. 2008 R_e=29 (+8,-5) pc; spherical Plummer approximation to reported radius. Not the 19.95 pc radius adopted in Horigome et al. 2022. No mixing of conventions.
literature_choices.mass: Simon et al. 2011 section V.3: M_1/2=5.8 (+8.2,-3.1)e5 Msun at rounded 3D radius 38 pc; fixed central mass used at exact Plummer rhalf=37.84 pc.
literature_choices.velocity: Binary-corrected intrinsic sigma=3.7 (+1.4,-1.1) km/s is a context check, not an additional exact normalization constraint.
literature_choices.errors: Constant 5 km/s Gaussian error approximates median error used in Simon et al. 2011 Fig. 9 (floor 2.2 km/s). Idealized equal errors, not the empirical per-star uncertainty distribution.
literature_choices.selection: 64 true members; random positions R<=87 pc; based on reported outer member extent, not reproduction of actual completeness. No binary velocities or foregrounds.
literature_choices.halo_rs: 150 pc controlled choice, r_s/R_e=5.17 comparable to previous experiment; not a literature best fit. Both gamma=1 and gamma=0 targets share this scale.
literature_choices.anisotropy: beta=-0.5 retained from previous controlled DF generator; not a Segue 1 measurement.
